args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Rain jacket or poncho

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburn relief)
- Shampoo and conditioner (travel-sized)
- Body wash or soap (travel-sized)
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Hair ties or clips
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Skincare products
- Insect repellent

Accessories:
- Sunglasses
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag or tote
- Reusable water bottle
- Waterproof phone case or dry bag

Electronics:
- Smartphone and charger
- Waterproof camera (optional)
- Power bank or portable charger
- Travel adapter (if needed)

Documents and Money:
- Passport or ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Flight itinerary and hotel reservations
- Credit/debit cards
- Cash (small bills for tips and local expenses)

Miscellaneous:
- Beach towel (quick-dry)
- Snorkel gear (if planning to snorkel)
- Waterproof sunscreen bag
- Travel pillow and eye mask (for long flights)
- Books or e-reader
- Waterproof journal or notebook

Health and Safety:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit (band-aids, pain relievers, etc.)
- Motion sickness medication (if needed)
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes

Activities and Entertainment:
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Waterproof watch
- Waterproof Bluetooth speaker (optional)
- Travel games or cards
- Waterproof phone pouch

Note: Check the weather forecast closer to your departure date to adjust your packing list accordingly.
